source: noop_floor block of scripts/analysis/j17_channel_fixes.py --noop-campaign, rerun 2026-09-24 (hpc job log ~/.hpc-spool/20260924-184440-3500342.out); every other block of that rerun is identical to campaign/results/j17_channel_fixes_20260924.report.json except census.ledger counts, which moved because the ledger gained the A10 rows

settings.clustering: scenario (primary: every p and ci95_pp_scenario) and task (ci95_pp_task)
settings.p_value: j10.bootstrap_pvalue(scenario means, threshold, 'two-sided'): 2 x the smaller tail
settings.crash_convention: error_type == 'crash' is dropped from every pair and counted in inputs

definitions.limit: error_type == 'limit' (the 40-step limit), scored; only error_type == 'crash' is dropped
definitions.tgc: j10.a1_arm_episodes' tgc (j10.score_tgc: a scored failure is 0), per-task binary
definitions.sgc: j10.a1_sgc_units [j10_report.py:2379-2400]: a (scenario, seed) unit passes iff every task of the scenario succeeded, scored only when all its tasks are non-crashed episodes; the rule of hj1_gate.scenario_goal_completion. Paired on shared units; scenario clusters
definitions.fenced_code: the intervention text contains an opening ``` line, text and a closing ``` (FENCED_BLOCK_RE)
definitions.chars: len() of the intervention text (payload.correction), in characters
definitions.interventions: every event_type == 'intervention' in the episode's last run_start segment (b2.read_events), over the arm's non-crashed episodes
definitions.copy_rate_show: b2_decomposition.copy_rate, the registered S definition, unchanged
definitions.copy_rate_advice: b2's next-action rule, renderer and whitespace normalisation, with the shown text widened to the advice text OR any ```python block inside it; denominator every intervention
definitions.per_episode_wall_s: manifest.json created_at (written just before system.run, src/sidekick/runner.py:369-388) to the run_end event's ts. Every other event ts is AppWorld's freezegun clock (src/sidekick/replay.py:76)
definitions.planner_call_latency_s: usage.latency_s of live planner events (provider not 'cache', n_calls >= 1); perf_counter runs under the same freezegun clock
